purpose: Planning images only. No implementation or deployment authorized.

prompts.prompt:
Create one exceptionally art-directed LANDSCAPE GAME LEVEL DESIGN SHEET, target 3072 x 2048, titled "THE OPEN ATRIUM". This is a complete visual planning proposal for a 2D SIDE-VIEW PIXEL-ART explorable personal portfolio world, NOT a production sprite sheet, not a webpage screenshot, not an isometric map. The user needs to SEE ALL OF THE MAP and understand how it connects. Prioritise cinematic, beautiful room compositions over diagram clutter.

Visual direction: a very small anime-adjacent swordsman traveller among normal sized benches, railings, doors, registry desk and lamps; enormous surreal modern civic architecture around them. Familiar empty public interiors, Monogatari-like compositional strangeness, Backrooms liminality WITHOUT horror. Warm dusk light, pale concrete, restrained vermilion signage, lavender shadows, a giant suspended ring-shaped housing block glimpsed through a roof opening, floating slabs in distant atmospheric depth. Crisp visible fine pixel clusters, selective detail, strong silhouettes, no realistic 3D render, no medieval castles/gothic arches. Sparse but inhabited, a couple of staff. Calm and fascinating.

Layout of the SHEET: upper 70% is a huge coherent side-on architectural sectional level map, beautifully illustrated as an interconnected world, with modest numbered callouts outside rooms and visually distinct usable platforms. Lower 30% is THREE wide cinematic camera-framing insets: Arrival, Arena threshold, and Exhibit outlook. These insets show actual SIDE-SCROLLER compositions, not overhead views. A tiny simple line legend separates routes and door links. The map must feel more spacious than a cramped dollhouse. Make all room names readable; minimal annotation, no paragraphs, no corporate graphic design ornaments.

Exact room arrangement and connections:
1 "ARRIVAL" is at middle level left, a safe human-scale platform opening into the enormous atrium.
2 "ACCOUNT REGISTRY" is immediately adjacent to arrival, literally a short walk right. A normal desk/table, one accountant sitting/standing behind it, a desk lamp. This is available without combat or a quest.
3 "CONCOURSE" is at the central middle level, main meeting point with a bench and one warm vending alcove. Connect Arrival -- Registry -- Concourse by walkable floor.
4 "ARENA" is to the RIGHT of Concourse via a broad short gated passage, clearly the most direct and important route. Draw a roomy flat fighting floor with one large readable guardian silhouette at rest and clear safe entry apron. Internal annotation: "Boss → product menu". No donation box inside active fight.
5 "ARCHIVE" is one floor BELOW Concourse, reached by short stairs and a normal freely opening door. Shelves normal height, distant ceiling vast. Annotation: "Door • no prerequisite". An alternate staircase returns to Registry; make the lower route a useful loop.
6 "WAITING ROOM" is a small cozy room LEFT of Concourse behind Registry, a sheltered lamp and a few normal chairs, no forced quest.
7 "SKY WALK" starts above Concourse via a staircase on its LEFT, leads up and across an exposed walkway overlooking the open vertical void. This is scenic exploration, not difficult jumping.
8 "EXHIBIT" is at upper RIGHT, reached after Sky Walk. A long quiet gallery in an impossible detached building, a few empty neutral frames, never actual existing artwork. Show the VOID and warm human-sized foyer. A return LIFT from Exhibit's right edge descends to Concourse via an open shaft; label "RETURN LIFT" and draw both stops so this is a clear shortcut, not a decorative dead-end.
ARCHIVE and EXHIBIT are separate, not one library.
No other service rooms. In particular NO TREASURY.
Mark FIVE small donation boxes on safe landings: Registry, Concourse, Waiting Room, Archive entrance, Exhibit foyer. Every box has a small adjacent donor plaque with blank rows; legend exactly "D = donate + top donors". No invented donor names or amounts.
Show one clear main-route accent from arrival through registry/concourse to arena, a secondary scenic route to exhibit, and return links. Path lines must follow actual walkable platforms and stairs, never suggest walking through empty air. Door links use a different dashed line, lifts vertical with two stops.
One footer line: "Planning concept • gameplay above / full website on scroll". Everything is a proposed map, not fictional shipping status.

The whole room compositions are being established FIRST. Each room must have a distinct frame, intentional floor height, sightline and proportion, while materials tie them together. Keep large backgrounds much larger than normal foreground objects. Player is tiny but visible with a red scarf or coat accent, sword sheathed; only one full-map spawn marker at ARRIVAL. No explanatory lore block, no subtitle tagline, no fake accounts or leaderboard data. The sheet should be clear enough that a level designer can trace every room connection while the owner can fall in love with the actual world.

Edit this existing game level planning sheet precisely. Preserve the title THE OPEN ATRIUM, the 8 labelled spaces, overall room arrangement, narrow small traveller, huge suspended architecture, warm/pale/lavender materials, legible route overlays and three inset views. This is a quiet mysterious 2D pixel-art game, not a real estate advertisement.

REQUIRED CORRECTION 1: Remove ALL decorative slogans, inspirational sentences, subtitles and marketing phrases throughout the entire image and inset views. In particular delete the subtitle beneath THE OPEN ATRIUM, and every phrase on walls or banners such as A BRIGHTER ORDINARY, PLACES PEOPLE IDEAS STILL MEET HERE, SAME SKIES MORE ROOM, A QUIETER BRIGHTER YOU, PUBLIC SPACES BRIGHTER PEOPLE, FURTHER STILL HUMAN, HIGHER TOGETHER. Leave those surfaces visually plain concrete or plain muted red cloth with minimal geometric marks. Do not replace these with any new writing. The ONLY remaining text may be the main title, the existing numbered room labels, SPAWN, Boss → product menu, Door • no prerequisite, RETURN LIFT, route legend, D = donate + top donors, and the bottom Planning concept line. No other text at all.

REQUIRED CORRECTION 2: Relocate the return lift from the far right end of the arena to the narrow vertical area between the CONCOURSE and arena, aligned with the LEFT edge of the EXHIBIT. The top stop connects to the exhibit foyer. The bottom stop opens onto the SAFE CONCOURSE outside the arena's entry gate. Show a complete elevator shaft, cabin and TWO landings. Delete the old far-right shaft and its purple route. The arena itself must have one long unobstructed flat combat floor; nobody has to enter a fight when returning from the gallery. Preserve the safe entry gate and make the new lift route clear.

REQUIRED CORRECTION 3: Make the artwork more unmistakably pixel art, with coherent visible square clusters on the human-scale floor, furniture and characters. Keep distant forms quieter/finer. Do not apply crude global mosaic or compromise the readable planning annotations. Keep side-view surfaces flat and the comparison scene airy. No new room or feature. All gallery frames stay neutral blank placeholders. Keep the three donation/safe-service route colours clearly separate. Do not add any slogan or subtitle.

Create ONE gorgeous but highly legible 2D PIXEL-ART GAME MAP PLANNING SHEET, landscape target 3072 x 2048. Title exactly "THE COURTYARD BETWEEN". A COMPLETE DIFFERENT MAP CONCEPT for an explorable portfolio: uncanny familiar school/civic spaces linked around an open courtyard and a handful of impossible doors. Art direction combines empty anime architectural compositions with Backrooms-like spatial wrongness, calm curiosity, no horror. It is a side-scrolling world with responsive sword combat, not a top-down RPG. Whole-room concept art FIRST. NOT a loose asset sheet or a feature dashboard.

Sheet structure: upper 70% one carefully composed ILLUSTRATED SIDE-ELEVATION LEVEL MAP of the entire connected world. Lower 30% three vivid wide camera shots titled "ARRIVAL", "POOL CROSSING", "EXHIBIT". Room connections must be explicit. Orthographic side-view floors and platforms, no isometric dollhouse. Use cinematic atmospheric depth only in the unreachable backgrounds. Crisp visible pixel art: exact-looking square clusters, restrained dithering, detailed but low-resolution sprites, no painterly smears. Human-sized objects establish scale, tiny traveller with muted red coat/hair and sheathed katana. Familiar daytime aqua school tiles, cool deep-blue shadows, peach light, limited vermilion doors. Enormous impossible clear sky and a residential block suspended upside down behind the courtyard. Quiet, strange, beautiful; only two or three residents.

Map topology and physical composition:
"ARRIVAL" at bottom-left-middle opens into a low ordinary sheltered entrance, shoes/cubby and bench, small spawn marker.
"ACCOUNT REGISTRY" directly to its right shares the same floor, only a few steps away. A NORMAL desk, papers, lamp and accountant; no giant monument, no signup gate.
"COURTYARD" central mid-level has the largest open view and a lone human-sized tree/bench. Arrival--Registry--Courtyard are visibly continuous floor.
"ARENA" to the RIGHT of courtyard is a vast empty indoor gymnasium transformed into a quiet guardian court. A short direct corridor includes safe "VESTIBULE" outside the arena doors. Long clear flat combat floor, one elegant grounded masked sword guardian, no huge effects. Text below label only "Boss → product menu". Make this the obvious main route and keep it visually short.
"ARCHIVE" BELOW courtyard, linked by two stairways making a lower loop between Registry and Vestible. Ordinary freely opening door, shelves, paper records; annotate "Door • no prerequisite". No puzzle or boss to enter.
"EMPTY CLASSROOM" ABOVE and LEFT of courtyard, reached by a clear stair from courtyard. Only a few normal desks scattered in an unnaturally long room.
"POOL CROSSING" ABOVE centre, reached via an impossible door from Empty Classroom: mark both door frames with the same small BLUE CIRCLE symbol and connect their endpoints with a restrained BLUE DASHED LINE in planning overlay. Pool is a shallow reflecting body in a huge space; an easy continuous narrow walkway crosses it, no swimming requirement or precision platforming.
"ROOF WALK" to the RIGHT of Pool Crossing, physical short ascending stairs to open sky and modest handrail, immense surreal suspended architecture far behind.
"EXHIBIT" upper right after Roof Walk. Warm quiet long gallery with distinct human-scale hanging frames, all neutral empty stand-ins. One paired RED SQUARE door at gallery exit connects straight back to the COURTYARD safe area. Draw corresponding RED SQUARE door at courtyard and a matching dashed return connection. This is a convenient return after discovery, not a jump into the arena.
The art route is the longer scenic circuit through classroom → pool → roof → exhibit, while the arena and archive remain easy to reach.
NO TREASURY ROOM.
Place FIVE small donation boxes with adjacent top-donor plaques/blank lines at Registry, Courtyard, safe Vestibule, Pool landing, Exhibit foyer. Legend exactly "D = donate + top donors". Never inside combat or blocking a walkway. No donor names, money amounts, social proof or fictional statistics.
One solid muted-orange planning path on actual floors shows main route to arena; one solid turquoise path follows scenic walkways; dashed paired-symbol links indicate doors. Show stairs clearly; do not draw walking lines through empty air. Return route must be traceable.
Bottom tiny line: "Planning concept • gameplay above / full website on scroll".
Typography outside scenery: small refined legible labels and slim leader lines. WHITELIST OF TEXT: title, named room labels, SPAWN, Boss → product menu, Door • no prerequisite, D = donate + top donors, "Walk", "Door link", "Return", bottom planning line. ABSOLUTELY NO OTHER TEXT. No subtitles, inspirational slogans, mottos, marketing text, wall quotes or fake Japanese writing. Walls and banners stay plain or have geometric colour marks. Do not fill negative space with invented words.
Make the normal rooms and huge empty backgrounds contrast strongly; preserve real room separation rather than a long single corridor. This needs to be an evocative, practical entire map proposal, with close-up insets that feel like actual beautiful pixel-art side-scroller screenshots.

Edit ONLY the route connectivity on this existing planning sheet THE COURTYARD BETWEEN. Keep its entire visual style, title, beautiful rooms, upside-down city, palette, small characters, existing labels, main orange route, archive stairs, red return door link, donation points and all three bottom camera insets unchanged.

Fix the upper art journey:
1. Add a real, clearly drawn human-scale staircase from the LEFT edge of the middle-level COURTYARD next to ACCOUNT REGISTRY, rising leftward along the exterior to a narrow landing at the RIGHT edge of EMPTY CLASSROOM. Both its bottom and top must visibly touch those floors. Show the turquoise scenic route starting on the courtyard floor, following every stair, and entering the classroom. A visitor must actually be able to reach the upper route from arrival.
2. Remove the existing direct physical bridge/descending walkway connecting EMPTY CLASSROOM to POOL CROSSING. Leave an unmistakable open-air gap between those two separate rooms. The ONLY connection across this gap is the existing BLUE CIRCLE paired DOORS and BLUE DASHED planning line. Draw turquoise path INTO the classroom blue door and restart it AT the pool blue door, following the pool's narrow safe walkway through ROOF WALK into EXHIBIT. Do not draw a solid walking line across the gap or through air.
3. Keep the red EXHIBIT return door connected to the safe COURTYARD/VESTIBULE doorway, outside combat. Keep Archive accessible from the main floor without a prerequisite.
No new words, rooms, slogans, explanatory text or decorative changes. This is a precise connectivity correction, not a redesign.

Create ONE landscape 3072 x 2048 illustrated GAME LEVEL DESIGN SHEET titled exactly "SUSPENDED INTERCHANGE". A genuinely distinct third concept: a sparse archipelago of normal municipal waiting rooms, registry counters and passageways suspended in immense nocturnal space. This is a full 2D SIDE-SCROLLING PIXEL ART world map plus beautiful close-up room compositions. No isometric view, no realistic3D, no medieval fantasy castles, no horror. Actual coherent pixel clusters and finely controlled selective detail. Small anime swordsman traveller, ordinary human-scale furniture. Dark ink-violet and teal atmosphere, milk-white fluorescent lights, a few warm amber windows and muted-red doors. Monumental impossible background: an enormous floating circular reservoir and upright apartment slabs extending beyond view, distant reflecting water hanging in the sky. The water and structures are unreachable atmospheric backgrounds, never confused with walkable foreground.

Upper 70% of sheet: ONE entire SIDE-ELEVATION MAP, with separated architectural islands connected by explicit walking platforms, door links and one functional lift. Plenty of deep open space between islands, short purposeful playable links. Lower 30%: three wide cinematic side-view camera insets titled "ARRIVAL", "OVERLOOK", "EXHIBIT". First inset must feel extraordinary: normal little bench + lit registry window under a bus-shelter-like roof, tiny katana traveller, giant suspended reservoir far beyond, lots of black/teal negative space. Second inset is a narrow human-scaled balcony giving an enormous distant view. Third is a warm quiet artwork room, blank neutral frames, suspended in cool emptiness.

Exact map and connections, all labels readable:
Main floor from LEFT to RIGHT: "ARRIVAL" -> immediately adjacent "ACCOUNT REGISTRY" -> "INTERCHANGE" -> "VESTIBULE" -> "ARENA". Show this as a short continuous main bridge/walkway with a restrained solid orange route on its floor. Registry has a modest table/desk and accountant, available a few steps after spawn, no quest or combat. Interchange is a slightly sheltered hub. Vestibule is SAFE and sits outside clearly drawn arena doors. Arena has a large unobstructed rectangular combat floor with one lit sword guardian at rest; annotation exactly "Boss → product menu". No boxed-menu showroom; it is an actual place. No donation inside combat.
"ARCHIVE" is BELOW Interchange, via a short clearly drawn stairway. An ordinary openable door leads to normal-height shelves in an unnaturally tall room. Annotation "Door • no prerequisite". A second stairway returns to Registry, forming a small lower loop.
The SCENIC GALLERY CIRCUIT:
A complete visible lift shaft rises from the LEFT side of Interchange floor to an "OVERLOOK" platform directly above, two clear landing doors, label "LIFT".
Overlook leads LEFT along a short level balcony to a small "WAITING ROOM" with a warm light and one seated resident; both platforms visibly connect.
A paired BLUE CIRCLE DOOR in Waiting Room connects through a thin BLUE DASHED planning line to another BLUE CIRCLE DOOR at "WATER PASSAGE", a separate island HIGHER and to the RIGHT above the arena. This is a calm narrow continuous walkway under suspended shallow water, with rails and dry safe footing; no swimming or precision gap.
Water Passage leads via a clearly connected short ascent to "EXHIBIT" at upper far RIGHT, a serene long room with empty neutral frames. The art approach has three distinct compositions: overlook, intimate waiting room, water passage, then exhibit.
A paired RED SQUARE exit door in Exhibit has a thin dashed RED connection back to a RED SQUARE door in the safe Interchange. It must NOT end in the arena. Label only "Return" on dashed line.
Show every doorway/lift stop visibly, every solid walking path on actual floor. Avoid diagonal arrows pretending people can fly.
Five small donation boxes at Registry, Interchange, Waiting Room, Archive entrance, Exhibit foyer. Each has a small nearby plaque with blank rows. Legend exactly "D = donate + top donors". No invented donor names or amounts. NO TREASURY ROOM.
This is nonlinear: small lower archive loop, direct arena branch, bigger upper gallery circuit, immediate gallery return. Layout should make the arena visibly closest important destination while the exhibit is a scenic choice.
Text whitelist only: main title, specified room labels, SPAWN, LIFT, Boss → product menu, Door • no prerequisite, D = donate + top donors, Walk, Door link, Return, and tiny footer "Planning concept • gameplay above / full website on scroll". NO subtitles, taglines, slogans, explanatory story paragraphs, wall quotations, marketing text, Japanese writing, extra room labels or fake statistics. Plain colour-coded signs and geometric symbols are sufficient.
Refined planning annotations stay outside the compositions with thin leader lines, allowing the architecture and atmosphere to dominate. Large-scale backgrounds backed by human-sized foreground furnishings, sparse small characters, clearly distinct spaces. Every inset should look like a compelling fine-pixel-art game screenshot.

Make ONE precise correction to this planning image, preserving everything else.

The staircase between EMPTY CLASSROOM and COURTYARD currently ends in mid-air. Remove that entire staircase and replace it with a complete TWO-STOP ELEVATOR. Its bottom landing MUST sit directly on the main COURTYARD walking floor, at exactly the same height as the orange route by the left side of the tree. Its top landing MUST sit directly on the EMPTY CLASSROOM floor, at the same height as the classroom desks. Show a tall continuous shaft from the orange walking floor all the way up to the classroom elevation, with short horizontal landing bridges if needed. Both doors are accessible from actual floors. Label it "LIFT". Delete the old floating turquoise arrow. The turquoise scenic route starts on the COURTYARD floor, goes vertically through this lift, exits left into EMPTY CLASSROOM, and reaches the BLUE CIRCLE door.

Keep the blue dashed door transition from classroom to pool; no direct physical walkway between those rooms. Keep all room names, account registry, archive, arena, exhibit, red return link, donation boxes, colour palette, upside-down city and three lower camera insets unchanged. Do not add anything else. No slogans, subtitles or new art.
